rationale: a planned row records intent without a current digest
a completed row records the immutable record locator
a planned row must not carry a record digest as its target selector
an empty snapshot must not use placeholder identity values
a snapshot points at the record and never copies its body
a repository-owned artifact records no provider state
a planned row must record every reviewed column
each affected requirement must have one link-review row
a planned row must not carry a canonical record locator
